models.note: High-resolution piano transcription with pedals: onset F1 96.77, pedal F1 91.86 on MAESTRO (Kong et al. 2020). Third-party ONNX export; the upstream code is Apache-2.0 but these weights were not published by the authors. Load with graph optimisations disabled: ORT's MatMul+BatchNorm fusion mis-infers a rank-3 Gemm in this graph.
